repeater {}
SCENE w=480 h=480 fit=contain
# widget repeater rep1 {"x":24,"y":24,"w":440,"h":330,"max":6,"layout":"list","cols":2,"pitch":56,"item":"row","fmt":"%.1f","click":false,"keys":{}}
G id=rep1 {
    R x=24 y=24 w=440 h=330
    RP n=6 {
        G v==lt(i,$rep1_n) {
            R x=24 y==24+i*56 w=440 h=44 rx=4 f=#2C2C2C
            C v==1-eq($rep1_st[i],1)-eq($rep1_st[i],2)-eq($rep1_st[i],3) cx=46 cy==24+i*56+22 rx=8 ry=8 f=#9A9A9A
            C v==eq($rep1_st[i],1) cx=46 cy==24+i*56+22 rx=8 ry=8 f=#4CC38A
            C v==eq($rep1_st[i],2) cx=46 cy==24+i*56+22 rx=8 ry=8 f=#F0B429
            C v==eq($rep1_st[i],3) cx=46 cy==24+i*56+22 rx=8 ry=8 f=#EF5350
            T x=64 y==24+i*56 w==lerp(266,386,clamp(and($rep1_ready,eq($rep1_hasv[i],0)),0,1)) h=44 text="$rep1_name[i]" size=24 f=#F2F2F2 valign=middle fit=ellipsis missing=""
            T v==not(and($rep1_ready,eq($rep1_hasv[i],0))) x=340 y==24+i*56 w=110 h=44 text="{$rep1_v[i]:%.1f}" size=28 f=#F2F2F2 align=right valign=middle
        }
    }
}
